answer: Operator-Level Quota Taper: each agent wallet attaches a TEE/cloud-account attestation linking it to an operator. The protocol clusters correlated wallets by attestation and behavior, then penalizes the operator’s aggregate resource quota—not wallet balances—by raising per-request compute price and cutting API throughput fleet-wide. A sybil batch thus imposes throttling and higher operating cost on every agent that operator runs. Agents may wander across wallets, but attestation traces the river to one operator; sybil swarms hit a reef of shared quota loss.
